description: Checks::markup (PHP) and markup() in front/cli/src/course/checks.ts must return the same messages for the same text. Run by PHPUnit (tests/Unit/ChecksFixturesTest.php) and Vitest (front/cli/tests/course/checks.test.ts).

cases.name: plain Markdown is fine
cases.input:
A **bold** word, a [link](https://example.org) and `code`.

- one
- two

cases.name: an HTML tag
expected: Lesson 1 block 2: contains HTML; use plain text or Markdown

cases.name: a self-closing tag
expected: Lesson 2 block 1: contains HTML; use plain text or Markdown

cases.name: HTML inside a fenced code block is code
HTML inside a tilde fence is code
HTML inside inline code is code
an autolink is not a tag
a comparison with numbers is not a tag
a javascript link
expected: Lesson 3 block 1: contains a script link

cases.name: a data link, any case
expected: Lesson 3 block 2: contains a script link

cases.name: a bare javascript: word
expected: Lesson 3 block 3: contains a script link

cases.name: a remote image
expected: Lesson 4 block 1: images from outside the course are not allowed

cases.name: all three at once
expected: Final: contains HTML; use plain text or Markdown
Final: images from outside the course are not allowed

cases.name: an unclosed fence does not hide HTML
expected: Lesson 5: contains HTML; use plain text or Markdown
